license_required.quote: A person may not knowingly practice public accounting unless the person is a certified public accountant or a public accountant

issuing_authority.value: Department of Business and Professional Regulation / Board of Accountancy
issuing_authority.quote: "Department" means the Department of Business and Professional Regulation

moral_character_required.quote: An applicant for licensure shall show that the applicant has good moral character.

degree_required.value: baccalaureate or higher degree with concentration in accounting and business, 150 semester hours
degree_required.quote: An applicant for licensure must have at least 150 semester hours of college education, including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by an accredited college or university, with a concentration in accounting and business

accrediting_body.quote: baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by an accredited college or university

required.quote: An applicant for licensure after December 31, 2008, must show that he or she has had 1 year of work experience.

duration.quote: must show that he or she has had 1 year of work experience

kind.value: accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting work experience
kind.quote: providing any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting skills, all of which must be verified by a certified public accountant

exams.name: CPA Licensure Examination
exams.notes: Applicant must complete 120 semester hours before sitting; 150 required for licensure
exams.quote: A person desiring to be licensed as a Florida certified public accountant shall apply to the department to take the licensure examination.

interval_years.quote: The department shall adopt rules establishing a procedure for the biennial renewal of licenses issued pursuant to this section.

required.quote: the board shall by rule require Florida certified public accountants to submit proof satisfactory to the board that during the 2 years prior to application for renewal, they have successfully completed not less than 48 or more than 80 hours of continuing professional education programs

hours_per_period.quote: not less than 48 or more than 80 hours of continuing professional education programs in public accounting subjects approved by the board

period_years.quote: during the 2 years prior to application for renewal

value: Not less than 10% of total hours in accounting-related and auditing-related subjects
Not less than 5% of total hours in ethics applicable to the practice of public accounting, including review of chapter 455 and this chapter
Additional requirements for CPAs engaged in audit of governmental entities
topical_requirements.quote: Not less than 10 percent of the total hours required by the board shall be in accounting-related and auditing-related subjects... Not less than 5 percent of the total hours required by the board shall be in ethics applicable to the practice of public accounting.

available.quote: The board shall certify as qualified for a license by endorsement an applicant who holds a valid license to practice public accounting issued by another state or territory of the United States

requirements.value: Holds valid license from another state with substantially equivalent criteria, or has met FL education/experience/moral character requirements and passed substantially equivalent exam; or holds license for 10+ years and passed equivalent exam
requirements.quote: Holds a valid license to practice public accounting issued by another state or territory of the United States, if the criteria for issuance of such license were substantially equivalent to the licensure criteria that existed in this state at the time the license was issued

regulatory_model.quote: A person may not knowingly practice public accounting unless the person is a certified public accountant or a public accountant

title_protection.quote: Assume or use the titles or designations "certified public accountant" or "public accountant" or the abbreviation "C.P.A." or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviations, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the person holds a license to practice public accounting under this chapter

scope_protection.quote: Perform or offer to perform any services described in s. 473.302(8)(a) or (d) unless such person holds an active license under this chapter and is a licensed firm, provides such services through a licensed firm, or complies with ss. 473.3101 and 473.3141.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of s. 455.227(1) or any other provision of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision of s. 455.227(1) or any other provision of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to procure a license by bribery or fraudulent misrepresentations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to procure a license to practice public accounting by bribery or fraudulent misrepresentations.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against by another state, territory, or country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice public accounting revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including the denial of licensure, by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of or pleading nolo contendere to a crime directly related to the practice of public accounting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of, or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction which directly relates to the practice of public accounting or the ability to practice public accounting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a false report or record, or willfully failing to file a required report or record
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report or record that the certified public accountant or firm knows to be false, willfully failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising goods or services in a fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising goods or services in a manner that is fraudulent, false, deceptive, or misleading in form or content.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing fraud, deceit, negligence, incompetency, or misconduct in the practice of public accounting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an act of fraud or deceit, or of negligence, incompetency, or misconduct, in the practice of public accounting.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any rule adopted pursuant to this chapter or chapter 455
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any rule adopted pursuant to this chapter or chapter 455.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing on a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing on a revoked, suspended, inactive, or delinquent license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency or the PCAOB
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency or the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performance of any fraudulent act in any jurisdiction while holding a Florida license or using practice privileges
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performance of any fraudulent act in any jurisdiction while holding a license to practice public accounting in this state or using practice privileges in this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain good moral character while applying for or holding a license or using practice privileges
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to maintain a good moral character as provided in s. 473.308 while applying for licensure, or while licensed in this state or using practice privileges pursuant to s. 473.3141.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide any written disclosure to a client or the public required by this chapter or board rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide any written disclosure to a client or the public which is required by this chapter or rule of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having equivalent practice privileges revoked or suspended by another jurisdiction for conduct that would be disciplinable in Florida
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having the same or equivalent practice privileges of a Florida certified public accountant or firm revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country as a result of activity in that jurisdiction which would have subjected the Florida certified public accountant or firm to discipline in this state.

definition_quote.value: Offering to perform or performing for the public one or more types of services involving the expression of an opinion on financial statements, the attestation as an expert in accountancy to the reliability or fairness of presentation of financial information, the utilization of any form of opinion or financial statements that provide a level of assurance, the utilization of any form of disclaimer of opinion which conveys an assurance of reliability as to matters not specifically disclaimed, or the expression of an opinion on the reliability of an assertion by one party for the use by a third party
definition_quote.quote: Offering to perform or performing for the public one or more types of services involving the expression of an opinion on financial statements, the attestation as an expert in accountancy to the reliability or fairness of presentation of financial information

value: Expression of opinion on financial statements
Attestation as to reliability or fairness of financial information
Utilization of any form of opinion or financial statements providing a level of assurance
Utilization of disclaimer of opinion conveying assurance of reliability
Expression of opinion on reliability of an assertion by one party for use by a third party
Services involving use of accounting skills, tax, management advisory, or consulting services
Preparation of financial statements not included in attest services
Attestation engagements in accordance with Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements
methods_authorized.quote: "Practice of," "practicing public accountancy," or "public accounting" means: (a) Offering to perform or performing for the public one or more types of services involving the expression of an opinion on financial statements... (b) ...services involving the use of accounting skills, or one or more types of tax, management advisory, or consulting services... (c) ...preparation of financial statements... (d) ...attestation engagements in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements.

value: Expression of opinion on financial statements
Attestation as to reliability or fairness of presentation of financial information
Utilization of any form of opinion or financial statements providing a level of assurance
Utilization of disclaimer of opinion conveying assurance of reliability as to matters not specifically disclaimed
Expression of opinion on reliability of an assertion by one party for use by a third party
Attestation engagements in accordance with Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements
attest_services_types.quote: Offering to perform or performing for the public one or more types of services involving the expression of an opinion on financial statements, the attestation as an expert in accountancy to the reliability or fairness of presentation of financial information, the utilization of any form of opinion or financial statements that provide a level of assurance

compilation_services_authorized.quote: Offering to perform or performing for the public one or more types of service involving the preparation of financial statements not included within paragraph (a), by a certified public accountant who holds an active license

education_semester_hours_required.quote: An applicant for licensure must have at least 150 semester hours of college education, including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by an accredited college or university

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: The applicant has completed 120 semester hours or 180 quarter hours from an accredited college or university with a concentration in accounting and business courses as specified by the board by rule

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: an individual who does not have an office in this state has the privileges of Florida certified public accountants and may provide public accounting services in this state without obtaining a license under this chapter or notifying or registering with the board or paying a fee

value: Consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board
Comply with this chapter and applicable board rules
Cease offering or rendering public accounting services in this state if home-state license is no longer valid
Appointment of the state board that issued the individual's license as agent for service of process
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: An individual certified public accountant from another state who practices pursuant to this section, and the firm that employs that individual, shall both consent, as a condition of the privilege of practicing in this state: (a) To the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board; (b) To comply with this chapter and the applicable board rules; (c) That if the license as a certified public accountant from the state of the individual's principal place of business is no longer valid, the individual will cease offering or rendering public accounting services in this state; (d) To the appointment of the state board that issued the individual's license as the agent upon whom process may be served

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: An individual who qualifies to practice under this section may perform the services identified in s. 473.302(8)(a) only through a firm that has obtained a license issued under s. 473.3101 or is authorized by s. 473.3101 to provide such services.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: Partners owning at least 51 percent of the financial interest and voting rights of the partnership are certified public accountants in some state.

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: All partners who are not certified public accountants in any state are engaged in the business of the partnership as their principal occupation.

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: a licensed firm or public accounting firm as defined in s. 473.302(7) and licensed under s. 473.3101 and engaged in the practice of public accounting as defined in s. 473.302(8)(a), except for the performance of compilations and reviews as those terms are defined by the board, must be enrolled in a peer review program.

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: The proceedings, records, and workpapers of a review committee are privileged and are not subject to discovery, subpoena, or other means of legal process or to introduction into evidence in a civil action or arbitration, administrative proceeding, or state accountancy board proceeding.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: A Florida certified public accountant may request that her or his license be placed in an inactive status by making application to the department.

retired_license_status_available.quote: A Florida certified public accountant who is at least 65 years of age, currently holds an active or inactive license in good standing under this chapter, and is not the subject of any sanction or disciplinary action may request that her or his license be placed on retired status by making application to the department.

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A firm that is not subject to the requirements of paragraph (1)(c) may perform other professional services while using the title "CPA," "CPA firm," or any other title... without a license issued under this section only if: (a) It performs such services through an individual with practice privileges granted under s. 473.3141

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: A client has a privilege to refuse to disclose, and to prevent any other person from disclosing, the contents of confidential communications with an accountant when such other person learned of the communications because they were made in the rendition of accounting services to the client.

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda made by a certified public accountant or firm or her or his employee incident to, or in the course of, professional services to a client... shall be and remain the property of the certified public accountant or firm in the absence of an express agreement between the certified public accountant or firm and the client to the contrary.

commission_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A certified public accountant or firm may not accept or pay a commission or referral fee in connection with the sale or referral of public accounting services as defined in s. 473.302(8)(a) and (c).

contingent_fee_prohibition_during_attest.quote: Public accounting services as defined in s. 473.302(8)(a) and (c), and those that include tax filings with federal, state, or local government, shall not be offered or rendered for a fee contingent upon the findings or results of such service.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: This paragraph does not prohibit the performance by persons other than certified public accountants of other services involving the use of accounting skills, including the preparation of tax returns and the preparation of financial statements without expression of opinion thereon

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: The board may adopt an alternative licensure examination for persons who have been licensed to practice public accountancy or its equivalent in a foreign country so long as the International Qualifications Appraisal Board of the National Association of State Boards of Accountancy has ratified an agreement with that country for reciprocal licensure.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: Any firm with an office in this state which performs services as defined in s. 473.302(8)(a)

cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available.quote: A Florida certified public accountant who is at least 65 years of age, currently holds an active or inactive license in good standing under this chapter... may request that her or his license be placed on retired status

government_audit_cpe_requirement.quote: The board shall adopt rules establishing the continuing education requirements for Florida certified public accountants who are engaged in the audit of a governmental entity.

independence_requirement_for_attest.quote: A certified public accountant shall not express an opinion on the financial statements of an enterprise unless she or he and her or his firm are independent with respect to such enterprise.
